criteria.mouth: 7 mouths × 5 eyelids × 3 gaze directions; only selected mouth pixels may change
criteria.brows: 16 brow pairs × 7 mouth/eyelid/gaze contexts; independent brow removal remains on its own side
criteria.gaze: 5 eyelid states × 9 directions; changes stay in actual visible apertures, closed eyes never show iris
criteria.original: Native original equals the owned source image regardless of target channels
criteria.limits: Exact RGBA comparisons; one source pixel of aperture/clip antialias allowance, strict destination rectangles. These checks cannot establish expression beauty or pose anatomy.
